name: Mishawaka 3x3 Day 2016

venue.name: St. Mark Missionary Church
venue.details: Due to space restrictions, this competition has a limit of 80 competitors. Be sure to register early to save your spot!

information: Preregistration cost is a $15 flat fee, payment is at the door, CASH ONLY If you do not Preregister, the cost is $20 and you may only compete in 3x3 speedsolve. We strongly recommend preregistering as it saves the organizers quite a bit of work.
